record.name: Structured AI
record.offering: The AI drawing review platform for architects and engineers.
record.description_evidence:
Structured AI is the most advanced AI-powered QA/QC platform for drawing packages, working across both PDF drawings and native Revit models. Architects and engineers use our platform to make every drawing set leave the office with certainty. 

Our AI agents learn your firm's standards, apply the relevant codes, and read every page of a set, then return a clear list of what's wrong, where it sits, and how to fix it. Run compliance reviews across thousands of pages in minutes, chat with your drawings for sourced answers, build custom checks in plain English, compare versions, overlay disciplines, and close out comments - all within a single platform, with a full audit trail on every finding.

For decades, the last line of defense on a drawing set has been a red pen at the end of a deadline week. But buildings have outgrown the red pen. A modern set runs thousands of drawings, and the errors hiding between them threaten quality and safety, not just cost. What manual review misses resurfaces as RFIs, change orders, and field rework, paid for in time, margin, and reputation.

Structured AI catches those errors before they leave the office, capturing the judgment of your best reviewer once and applying it everywhere.

Better drawings build a better world. #GetStructured
